name: Knockout Show
hook: Survive each round. Last one standing wins.
how: Three rounds: jump the spinning bar, dodge cannonballs while the floor drops away ring by ring, then a final on tiles that fall a moment after you step on them. Fall off and you're out. The last bean standing wins the crown.
controls: WASD or arrow keys and Space, or the touch stick and Jump button
uses: The host's browser runs the show and counts who is out; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Every bean, spinning bar and falling tile is the same for everyone.
Bots fill the show until enough people join.
Crowns: the players who won the most shows.
ideas: Add a race round to a finish line
Add costumes you unlock by winning
